items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Barby and Lenny, they were doing five, six arrangements a week.

ctx.x: But I know eight of us got out at the time and the Rhythm Boys had not come back with the band, so that they only had the other trio and it was getting down with whatever bands were around, big bands, were around at that time, so that he was entering a new phase with his band.

Now, he had to look forward to the radio business. The dance business had gone by and in this radio thing, you know, we weren't -- Ferde and I both, we were not used to that either. We were not you know, "Get this out by 8 o'clock." We were not used to that sort of thing. Barby and Lenny, they were doing five, six arrangements a week. Take a print, cut and paste, take it and throw it together and you take a chorus, I'll take a chorus," that was not the kind of thing that we were used to doing.

Ferde was used to trying to make his stuff, I was used to trying to do mine, and we hadn't for quite some time now, we hadn't been doing things like that, but these guys were now doing a radio type of show which the idea was to make enough arrangements.
